Cylinders shall be secured upright with proper support, protected from shock, heat and direct sunlight, and shall not be dropped, rolled or thrown while loading or unloading. Oxygen and acetylene cylinders shall be segregated in the vehicle as per the rules. The vehicle shall carry fire extinguishers, hazard labels (and an emergency information panel) as applicable. Cylinders shall not be carried along with passengers or incompatible goods. H.
